lines.text: Many learners say: I like to listen music.
Better: I like to listen to music.
Listen needs to before the thing.
Listen to! We listen to the radio.

data.right: I like to listen to music.
data.why: Listen needs to before the thing.

native.tip: listen 后面接听的内容时，要加 to：listen to music。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I like to listen music.”😅 中文“听音乐”直接接宾语，英语 listen 后面要加 to：“I like to listen to music.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: Before the thing you hear, listen needs to.
en.caption: Do you say “I like to listen music.” 😅 Before the thing you hear, listen needs to: “I like to listen to music.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
